about_the_game:
Dive into a meditative strategy game where you create and develop your dragon islands without timers or stress. Build breathtaking landscapes and watch as the islanders care for their toothy pets. It’s the perfect game for relaxation and creativity.

🏝️ Simple Design and Island Customization

Easily create beautiful islands with just a few simple tools. Customize the environment to suit your tastes. Build your perfect dragon paradise. No hassle!

🌟 Grow a Community for Your Dragons

Build a growing settlement and immerse yourself in its magical world. Watch as the residents lovingly raise their toothy pets and turn your island into a vibrant, thriving community. With every new home and every act of care for the dragons, the island comes alive, filling with warmth and charm.

🧩 Puzzle Mode

The game includes Puzzle Mode, which adds a new level of challenge and fun! In this mode, you’ll need to:

  • Recreate the island exactly as shown in the preview image.

  • Build the terrain and place objects in the correct positions.

  • Complete several levels across different biomes, each offering a unique challenge.

This mode is perfect for those who love solving puzzles and testing their attention to detail. It also introduces you to the core mechanics of the game and helps you master the basics of control.

🏠 Personalize Every Corner of Your Island

Your dragons will live with people who help you raise them. Build a cozy settlement for them.

  • Move, rotate, and resize houses.

  • Place windows and doors however you like!

  • Change colors and materials to make each house unique.

🎨 Creativity Without Limits

Dragon Spot isn’t just a game—it’s a platform for your creativity.

  • Share your maps via Steam Workshop and inspire other players.

  • Use puzzle mode to challenge other players or solve their maps.

Your island is your canvas. Let your imagination run wild!

💖 Perfect for Relaxation and Inspiration

Whether you want to spend an hour or a whole day, Dragon Spot offers a gentle and enjoyable experience. No rushing, no stress—just a cozy atmosphere and the chance to focus on creativity. Perfect for those who love building, decorating, and caring for virtual creatures.
